{{Top}}
A '''pocket cruiser''',<ref name="AGSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> or '''pocket-cruiser''', was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] such as the [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class]].<ref name="HSLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> Pocket cruisers were small by modern standards and easy to manufacture. They saw extensive service near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and were considered obsolete by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were considered the forerunners of larger Imperial cruisers like the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. Later considered relics, they were primarily used as space-going classrooms and police security picket ships.<ref name="AGSWU" />
